name: Name
compose.DOCKER_GID.what: The group of the Docker socket, given to the controller. Without it the controller cannot reach Docker.
compose.ADMIN_PORT.what: The host loopback port Compose publishes the admin on (inside its container it listens on 9443); also sets ADMIN_ORIGIN's default, https://localhost:<port>, and is the UDP port Compose publishes the direct path on (on the address ADMIN_UDP_BIND names).
compose.ADMIN_UDP_URL.what: Passed to the admin as ADMIN_UDP_URL. The installer sets it to the IPv4 address you reached the server at over SSH, unless .env sets it.
compose.ADMIN_UDP_BIND.what: The host address Compose publishes the direct path’s UDP port on. The installer sets 0.0.0.0, every address, whenever it sets ADMIN_UDP_URL or .env does, unless .env sets this.
compose.ADMIN_TIMEZONE.what: Passed to the admin as ADMIN_TIMEZONE.
compose.ADMIN_LANGUAGES.what: Passed to the admin as ADMIN_LANGUAGES.
compose.ADMIN_LOCAL_MCP.what: Passed to the admin as ADMIN_LOCAL_MCP.
compose.ADMIN_MAX_SESSIONS.what: Passed to the admin as ADMIN_MAX_SESSIONS, and to the controller as CONTROLLER_MAX_SESSIONS. The installer sets it from the server’s memory unless .env does: each session takes up to BROWSER_MEMORY_MIB plus 1152 MiB, and 1 GiB stays for the system.
compose.BROWSER_CPUS.what: Each browser session’s CPU limit, passed as CONTROLLER_BROWSER_CPUS.
compose.BROWSER_MEMORY_MIB.what: Each browser session’s memory limit, passed as CONTROLLER_BROWSER_MEMORY_MIB.
compose.DISPLAY_BACKGROUND.what: The color each session’s screen shows where no window is, passed as CONTROLLER_DISPLAY_BACKGROUND.
compose.DISPLAY_LOGO_FILE.what: A PNG each session’s screen shows in place of easi.run’s logo, passed as CONTROLLER_DISPLAY_LOGO_FILE. Mount the file into the controller with an override.
admin.ADMIN_ORIGIN.what: The exact origin people open the admin at. Every change a login makes, every sign-in and every viewer stream must come from it; an agent token’s request is refused only when it names another origin.
admin.ADMIN_ORIGIN.values: Starts with https://, no trailing slash.
admin.ADMIN_LISTEN.what: The HTTPS address inside the container.
admin.ADMIN_UDP_URL.what: Where viewers reach the admin’s UDP port, for the media’s direct path (WebTransport, on 0.0.0.0:9443/udp inside the container); unset, the admin does not answer on UDP and the media stay on the WebSocket.
admin.ADMIN_UDP_URL.values: https://host[:port], spelled as ADMIN_ORIGIN is; the demo refuses it.
admin.ADMIN_HOSTNAMES.what: Names on the self-signed certificate the admin makes; the next start remakes it when they change.
admin.ADMIN_HOSTNAMES.values: Comma-separated. To use your own certificate, put tls-cert.pem and tls-key.pem in ADMIN_STATE.
admin.ADMIN_OUTPUT.what: The screen size of every session but those the admin page starts, which take a common desktop size of the shape of the screen they are watched on.
admin.ADMIN_OUTPUT.values: WxH, even, 320–1920 by 240–1080, and not a size SVT-AV1 crashes on (one side 2–8 pixels past a multiple of 64, the other 10–16).
admin.ADMIN_MAX_SESSIONS.what: Browser sessions at once, yours and every agent token’s together.
admin.ADMIN_TIMEZONE.what: The browsers’ time zone when a session uses no egress.
admin.ADMIN_TIMEZONE.values: An IANA name, such as America/Sao_Paulo.
admin.ADMIN_LANGUAGES.what: The browsers’ languages, preferred first, when a session uses no egress.
admin.ADMIN_LANGUAGES.values: 1–8 tags such as pt-BR: a 2–3 letter language and up to two more subtags of 2–8 letters or digits.
admin.ADMIN_LOCAL_MCP.what: Serves MCP to local clients through admin mcp (see Agents). Unset in the public demo, it is off there.
admin.ADMIN_STATE.what: The password hash, the agent tokens’ hashes, and the TLS certificate and key.
admin.ADMIN_STATIC.what: The web client the admin serves: mine, or your own (see Custom clients).
admin.ADMIN_STATIC_PATH.what: Where the web client is served. Under a path, the admin’s own /api, /ws, /sdk and /mcp stay at the root, and /name sends the browser on to /name/.
admin.ADMIN_SDK.what: The viewer SDK, served at /sdk/ whatever ADMIN_STATIC holds.
admin.ADMIN_STREAMS.what: One directory per session, holding its display’s stream socket.
admin.ADMIN_DEMO_SECONDS.what: Turns on the public demo: each visitor’s turn, in seconds (see Public demo).
admin.ADMIN_DEMO_SITES.what: The demos a visitor may pick.
admin.ADMIN_DEMO_SITES.values: name=https://start/ pairs, comma-separated; names of 1–32 a–z letters, 1–16 sites.
admin.ADMIN_FRAME_ANCESTORS.what: The pages that may show the public demo in a frame (the frame-ancestors of every response’s Content-Security-Policy); unset, nothing may frame the admin.
admin.ADMIN_FRAME_ANCESTORS.values: Up to four https://host[:port] origins, comma-separated. Only with ADMIN_DEMO_SECONDS.
controller.IMAGE_DISPLAY, IMAGE_BROWSER,: Pinned by @sha256:, or a local name:tag resolved once at start (restart the controller after rebuilding one).
controller.STREAMS_VOLUME.what: The Docker volume mounted into each session’s display; the admin sees it at ADMIN_STREAMS.
controller.CONTROLLER_INSTANCE.what: This installation’s name: a prefix and label on every container, network and volume it creates. Cleanup touches only its own.
controller.CONTROLLER_INSTANCE.values: Up to 16 characters, a lowercase letter first, then a–z, 0–9, -.
controller.CONTROLLER_BROWSER_MEMORY_MIB: Each browser’s memory limit, swap included.
controller.CONTROLLER_MAX_SESSIONS.what: The most sessions the controller holds at once, whatever the admin asks.
controller.CONTROLLER_MAX_SESSIONS.value: 1–16. Keep it at or above ADMIN_MAX_SESSIONS.
controller.CONTROLLER_DISPLAY_BACKGROUND: The color each session’s screen shows where no window is, around the logo; unset, the brand’s light wash. A value it refuses stops the controller at start.
A PNG inside the controller’s container that each session’s screen shows in place of easi.run’s logo, at a fifth of the screen’s width at most, never enlarged. Read once at start: a file it refuses stops the controller.
A regular file, not a link, of at most 64 KiB: an 8-bit RGB or RGBA PNG at most 1024 pixels on each side.
controller.CONTROLLER_SOCKET.what: The socket it serves the admin on.
controller.CONTROLLER_ADMIN_UID.what: The only uid allowed to connect.
bench.CONTROLLER_BENCH_NETWORK.what: A Docker network the session proxies join, holding one extra destination.
bench.CONTROLLER_BENCH_NETWORK.values: All three BENCH variables together, or none.
bench.CONTROLLER_BENCH_FIXTURE.what: That destination, reachable by name without DNS.
bench.CONTROLLER_BENCH_SPKI_FILE.what: A file with the base64 SHA-256 of the destination’s public key: Chrome accepts a certificate with that key even when no authority vouches for it.
bench.CONTROLLER_BENCH_FIXTURE_ONLY.what: The walled garden: every address a browser asks for goes to that destination, and nothing else is reachable.
bench.CONTROLLER_BENCH_FIXTURE_ONLY.valu: 1. Needs CONTROLLER_MAX_SESSION_SECONDS and an internal network.
bench.CONTROLLER_MAX_SESSION_SECONDS.wha: The walled garden’s age limit: stops any session older than this, whatever the admin does, and removes this installation’s leftovers at start.
bench.CONTROLLER_MAX_SESSION_SECONDS.val: 10–3600. Required with CONTROLLER_BENCH_FIXTURE_ONLY, refused without it.
bench.CONTROLLER_BENCH_LANES.what: CPU sets for benchmark lanes, which a session’s lane picks.
